Subject: DevDay — post-event first-pass metrics and attendee exports

Team / partners — sending the first-pass numbers from DevDay (attached attendee export + quick notes). I ran a high-level funnel and a conservative attribution pass, attached as Attribution_Notes.xlsx. Key points: 

- Registrations: 4,220
- Unique check-ins (attendees): 1,095 (in-person + livestream)
- MQLs captured: 162 (CRM auto-created via form + badge scans)
- Sales-accepted leads (SAL): 48
- Pipeline influenced (opps opened within 90d with any DevDay touch): $1.2M ACV (gross)

The attribution sheet uses last-touch on the registration form by default, with a secondary manual pass for partners and BD outreach. I flagged 7 opportunities where BD outreach (Bluepeak) reported early engagement — those are highlighted. 

Actions I want before we finalize ROI: 
1) Sales ops to validate CRM UTM / touchpoint flags for the top 10 opps (Aditya).
2) Bluepeak to confirm which accounts they believe should have majority credit and provide call notes if available (Alex).
3) EventOps to confirm badge-scan export schema so we can reconcile duplicates (ops).

Attachments: DevDay_Attendee_List.csv, Attribution_Notes.xlsx

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor

Thanks for the summary, Grace. Quick heads-up from Bluepeak: we believe at least three of the opportunities listed as "event-first-touch" were driven primarily by our BD outreach the week before DevDay — we ran targeted outreach to the same accounts and had discovery calls on Mar 24–26. 

I can send call notes and sequences for those accounts, but pulling a hard line on last-touch form registration feels misleading for pipeline credit and for our joint payout calculations. Can we get a blended attribution model call? We don't need to re-run the entire funnel, but a 60/40 event/partner split on any opp where Bluepeak has call notes seems fair.

1) Aditya / Sales Ops to pull the canonical HubSpot touch timeline for the 10 highest-value opps flagged in the sheet. Include all inbound form, manual activity (calls/emails logged), partner sequence tags, and first/last-touch UTMs. (Action: Aditya, due EOD today)
2) Bluepeak to send call notes for accounts they say drove the conversations. If necessary, we can redact sensitive content. (Action: Alex, due EOD today)
3) EventOps: send the badge-scan schema and timestamped CSV so we can dedupe folks who registered multiple times. (Action: ops, due EOD tomorrow)
4) Marketing to produce a provisional blended attribution proposal (60/40 and 50/50 variants) for the top 10 opps so leadership can pick a policy. (Action: Grace, due tomorrow noon)

If we can get all inputs by tomorrow noon PT we can lock the ROI and prepare the partner payout worksheet by Fri. Monica — can you take the roll-up once we have Aditya's CRM extract? Vivek

Folks — pulled the HubSpot timelines for the top 12 opps in the spreadsheet (attached small excerpt below). Full export is in the Drive link Vivek shared once we finalize access. Note the UTMs on the registration form for 4 of the top 12 are blank — those look like manual badge scans that were later merged to duplicate contact records. 

Excerpt (top 5 by value):
- HB-1023 (Bluepeak lead) — first inbound activity: Bluepeak outreach 2026-03-25 (call logged), registration form 2026-03-27, opp created 2026-03-29 ($240k ACV)
- HB-1078 — registration form 2026-03-20, no partner activity logged, opp created 2026-03-31 ($80k ACV)
- HB-1102 (sponsor lead) — sponsor outreach 2026-03-22, registration 2026-03-23, opp created 2026-03-30 ($150k ACV)
- HB-1134 — manual badge scan only, registration null, opp created 2026-03-28 ($50k ACV)
- HB-1199 (Bluepeak lead) — Bluepeak outreach 2026-03-26, registration 2026-03-28, opp created 2026-03-30 ($120k ACV)

My recommendation (practical): for opps where partner outreach predates the registration and there's a logged call or email thread, split credit 60% partner / 40% event. For records with no partner activity logged, attribute to event. I can produce the exact numeric split in the export (adding a credit column) once Alex confirms the call notes to match.

Attachment: small excerpt (sent internally to Drive); full export will be dropped into: https://drive.company.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-DevDay-2026

-Aditya

Team / partners — thanks for the fast turnaround. I've consolidated the inputs from Aditya and Alex and finalized the ROI worksheet. Summary (conservative blended attribution):

- Gross influenced pipeline: $1,200,000 ACV
- Partner credit (Bluepeak + sponsors): $420,000 (35%)
- Event credit: $780,000 (65%)
- Marketing spend (sponsorship + booth + travel): $185,000
- Net influenced ROI (event-credit / spend): 4.21x

Attachments: DevDay_ROI_Final.pdf, KPI_rollup_20260402.csv

Notes and decisions: 
- For the 5 highest-value opps where Bluepeak had documented outreach prior to registration, we applied the 60/40 partner/event split as proposed. Aditya added a credit column in the HubSpot export for transparency.
- We treated sponsor-sourced outbound as partner credit (included in partner total).
- We will publish the partner payout worksheet Monday morning; partners will receive itemized lines and supporting logs.

Next steps: 
1) Finance will prepare a partner payout file (Sarah / Sponsor team) — target Monday EOD.
2) Growth/Marketing will bake these attribution rules into the next events SOP to avoid rework.
3) Ops to confirm badge-scan schema for future cleanup (ops).

Thanks everyone — great cross-team collaboration. I can present a 5-min summary at next week's GTM sync if helpful.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
